name: lightcone
description: Core workflow for a Lightcone / ASTRA analysis with the lightcone-cli (lc) toolchain: `lc-new` scopes a new analysis from a research question, `lc-cli` carries the lc execution reference (spec–code invariant, status interpretation, failure diagnosis), and `lc-feedback` files bug reports. Ships SessionStart/PostToolUse hooks that activate the project venv and validate astra.yaml on save, plus the lc-extractor subagent for literature extraction. Depends on the astra plugin. Use for any interactive work inside an lc / ASTRA project.
